fields.label: Property Name
fields.description: Canonical name for this property (e.g. 'Farbe', 'Material'). Matches the existing property_name on Item Ecommerce Property rows verbatim — the migration uses this as the join key.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Lower number = appears earlier on the storefront PDP. Initial seed comes from the legacy property_classifier regex priorities (100..900). Operator-editable — change here propagates on the next sync via Shopware property_group.position and Medusa metadata ordering.

fields.label: Display Name (DE)
fields.description: Optional friendly label shown in storefront filter sidebar (DE). Falls back to property_name when empty.

fields.label: Display Name (EN)
fields.description: Optional friendly label shown in storefront filter sidebar (EN). Falls back to property_name when empty.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Property = filterable storefront facet. Text = non-filterable Technische-Daten row. Custom Field = product detail page only.

fields.label: Custom Field Data Type
fields.options:
text
html
boolean
number
select
datetime

fields.label: Options
fields.description: Known values for this property. Operator can reorder via display_order on each row. Item rows whose value is not in this list are appended last (alphabetical) in canonical output.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Free-text. Migration notes (type-conflict resolution etc.) get appended here automatically.
